title: gold_spent always 0 in wave_log despite towers being built
detail: Every wave_log entry across all 8 sessions shows gold_spent=0, yet towers are clearly built (towers_built arrays show 2-15 towers with total_cost up to 2275 gold). Gold is being spent on tower construction but the wave_log does not record it. This means economy analysis (gold efficiency per wave, spending curves, investment timing) is impossible from the reports. Note: gold_earned IS tracked for some waves (non-zero values appear), so the issue is specific to the spending tracking path.

suggested_fix.description: The wave_log gold_spent accumulator is likely not hooked into the tower purchase path. When executeAutoPlayAction() builds a tower, it should increment the current wave's gold_spent counter by the tower cost. Check if the spending is tracked per-wave or only globally.
